rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.

rules.citation: LAHD — Evictions for Non-Payment of Rent (RSO & JCO)
rules.quoted_span: Effective March 27, 2023, landlords may not evict a tenant who falls behind in rent unless the tenant owes an amount higher than the Fair Market Rent (FMR)
rules.plain_language: For every RSO and JCO rental unit in Los Angeles, a landlord may not evict for nonpayment unless the tenant owes more than the Fair Market Rent for the unit's bedroom size.
rules.explanation: Result=applies as_of=2025-12-31. No structured coverage test; jurisdiction match. Facts: year_built=1927, units=32. Source D040 retrieved 2026-10-01T22:36Z.

rules.citation: L.A. Mun. Code ch. XV (RSO) — LAHD RSO overview
rules.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage
rules.plain_language: Rental property first built on or before October 1, 1978 may receive a rent increase only once every 12 months and only at the LAHD allowable percentage; increases needing LAHD approval are listed separately by LAHD.

rules.explanation: Result=applies as_of=2025-12-31. Coverage conditions satisfied or not applicable. Facts: year_built=1927, units=32. Source D041 retrieved 2026-10-01T22:36Z.

July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026
